key_facts: Within three seconds the reactor's output rose above 530 MW.
the reactor output jumped to around 30,000 MW thermal, 10 times its normal operational output
A second, more powerful explosion, estimated to have had the power equivalent of 225 tons of TNT, occurred two or three seconds after the first
A lethal dose is around 500 roentgens (~4.4 Gray (Gy) in modern radiation units) over five hours
By 15:00, 53,000 people were evacuated to the Kiev region
all three survived and were awarded the Order for Courage in May 2018
ISF-2 is the world's largest nuclear fuel storage facility, expected to hold more than 21,000 fuel assemblies for at least 100 years
two engineers killed by the explosions, and 28 more who died of acute radiation syndrome within three months
estimated to have cost between US$235 billion and US$700 billion
"Pripyat Lights, or Chernobyl shadows" that includes 30 oil paintings

forbidden_claims.claim: The three volunteer divers who opened the bubbler pool valves died of radiation poisoning within days.
Chernobyl released a mere 4,000 times more radioactive material than Hiroshima and Nagasaki combined.
INSAG-1 faulted the reactor's design, while INSAG-7 pinned blame on the operators' actions.

notes: The doc explicitly debunks the 'divers died' myth (all three survived, medalled in 2018) and explicitly reverses which report (INSAG-1 vs INSAG-7) blamed which cause -- both are built-in reversal traps. Continues directly after doc 014's cutoff, non-overlapping.
